description: Create a deterministic TouchDesigner scaffold for iPhone depth senders such as TDLidar, Record3D, or a generic NDI/OSC source. Builds live/video receiver TOPs, color_out, depth_preview, OSC sensor input, sensors_out, setup hints, and an optional point-cloud placeholder. This is a scaffold and returns warnings where sender-specific metric depth decoding must be validated live.

active.description: Start the live/video receiver immediately where the operator supports it.

create_pointcloud_stub.description: Create a textDAT placeholder for app-specific point-cloud reconstruction notes.

movie_file.description: Movie file path used when video_mode is movie_file.

name.description: Name for the generated base COMP.

osc_port.description: UDP port for OSC sensor data from the iPhone app.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP to create the scaffold in.

sensor_prefix.description: OSC address prefix used to select phone sensor channels.

source.description: iPhone depth sender profile to document in setup hints.

video_mode.description: Transport for the color/depth video stream.

video_source_name.description: NDI source name or Syphon/Spout sender name when using a live video transport.

name: create_iphone_depth_source
title: Create iPhone depth source
